    • Constructor Detail

      • OrderFileLoader

        public OrderFileLoader​(java.lang.String delimiter,
                       OrderValidator validator)
        Creates a loader that splits lines on the given delimiter.
        Parameters:
        delimiter - the field separator, e.g. ","
        validator - supplies the rules for reading numbers, prices and yes/no values
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the delimiter is empty or the validator is missing

    • Method Detail

      • resolvePath

        public java.nio.file.Path resolvePath​(java.lang.String rawPath)
        Turns the text the user typed into a file path, rejecting blank names, names with illegal characters, and files that are not .txt files. Quotes around the path (added by Windows "Copy as path") are removed.
        Parameters:
        rawPath - the file name or path as typed
        Returns:
        the file path to open
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - with a friendly message if the name is not usable

      • readLines

        public java.util.List<java.lang.String> readLines​(java.lang.String filePath)
                                           throws java.io.IOException
        Reads every line of a text file. The file is read as UTF-8; if it was saved in an older Windows encoding, it is read again as ISO-8859-1 so the program still works instead of failing.
        Parameters:
        filePath - the file name or path as typed by the user
        Returns:
        every line in the file, in order
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the file name itself is not usable
        java.io.IOException - if the file is missing, a folder, unreadable or too large

      • isBlankOrComment

        public boolean isBlankOrComment​(java.lang.String line)
        Checks whether a line should be skipped because it is empty or a comment.
        Parameters:
        line - one line from the file
        Returns:
        true if the line is blank or starts with #

      • parseLine

        public Order parseLine​(java.lang.String line)
        Turns one line of the file into an Order. This checks the FORMAT of each field (is the quantity a number? is the date a real date?).
        Parameters:
        line - one line from the file
        Returns:
        the Order described by the line
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - with a message naming the bad field
